scope: Existing-table reaggregation and incremental-evidence audit; no new biological data, synthetic experiment, download or FASTQ rescan.
analysis_design: Retrospective synthesis. Baselines, Q20 and thresholds1/2/3 inherited from CODE19; not new preregistration or outcome-tuned method development.
eligibility: Preserve CODE19 fixed k < target span rule. Targets with span <=81 are ineligible for fixed k81; not zeros. near_full=span-1. Aliases may share one native group.
common_cohort: Intersection of eligibility for all fixed k31..81. Report matched denominators explicitly; selected frozen catalog, not random genome sampling.
fixed_control_strata: Define once per accession/state using Q20/raw-pair-support>=2 at k31: CONCORDANT_POSITIVE when exact>=2; DISCORDANT when pooled>=2 and exact<2; BELOW_THRESHOLD otherwise. These are evidence controls, not known biological positives/negatives. Include every cell, no downsampling.
candidate_rules: Pooled, same-pair and same-read at each fixed k and near-full; cell-level conjunctions of pooled k81 AND same-pair k31, and pooled k81 AND same-read k31. A conjunction does not assert the same observed pairs satisfy both criteria and has no inferred joint-support count. Fixed descriptive composites for this retrospective audit; no performance-selected threshold tuning.
count_vs_call: Keep numeric support-count equality separate from thresholded call equality. Extra rejection relative to exact does not establish a corrected genotype or true negative.
signature_scope: Complete ordered-pair sequence signature census is available only for60selected accession/state cells in CODE24. Other5244cells are NOT_MEASURED; never fill unknown values with zero or transfer across accessions.
support_comparison: Fullcatalog uses raw read-pair observations. In selected60cells only, compare the same observations before/after sequence-signature collapse with the same Q20 and thresholds. Do not mix raw counts and signatures in one denominator.
selection_warning: 663states were discovered using four other accessions;8unused accessions are same-study holdout, not external validation. Multiple states share underlying pairs; no independent-trial p-values.
scope_limits: No genomic absence, genotype, GWAS, sensitivity or false-positive-rate estimation from the real-data comparisons.
No new automata algorithm superiority is inferred from evidence disagreement or exact-string implementation.
The original60cases are selected discrepancies, not an unbiased accuracy panel.
Near-full and fixed-k aliases are dependent comparisons, not replicated experiments.
CODE25 simulations are contextual evidence and kept separate from real-data denominators.
If simple baselines and exact counts/calls agree, record that equality rather than inventing extra performance gains.
